newsitem.title: USA: Yellow Corp Q4 loss widens after charge.
newsitem.headline: Yellow Corp Q4 loss widens after charge.

text.p: Yellow Corp said Friday it took a special pretax charge of $46.1 million in the fourth quarter ended December 31, resulting in a net loss of $23.9 million in the period.
The company reported a net loss of $22.7 million in the corresponding period one year ago.

Yellow said the charge stems from the writedown of nonoperating real estate and computer software assets, an early retirement program, the reduction of a company car program and other organizational changes, particurlarly severance.
The company said revenues reached $781 million in the fourth quarter, up from $746 million one year ago.
Yellow is a transportation services provider.
Its shares were trading up 1/4 Friday at 16-5/8.
